withoutKey.headline: 3 of 21 capabilities have a provider adapter on this build, and 0 of them can be used right now: a capability is USABLE only when a provider has a real call() implementation AND its key is in this process's environment. The two numbers are kept apart because an adapter that cannot be reached is not a working capability — the rest are listed with their true state (key missing, or unbuilt), because "not wired" is information and "coming soon" is not.
